mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 15 degrees now, scattered clouds. Next 24 hours: high 14, low 10.

NATO allies and the Pentagon will discuss a possible drawdown of U.S. troops from Europe, reviewing Washington's current force levels on the continent.

Kosovo will play Ireland in Dublin tonight, needing only one point to clinch a Nations League play-off place.

Kosovo forward Edon Zhegrova suffered a brief alarm after a collision in Italy, but doctors say there is no serious injury and he could return to the pitch soon.

A UK Crown Court in Norwich acquitted FSK member B.H. of all charges, the Ministry of Defence said.

A Serbian nationalist song performed at an EU forum sparked controversy after Kosovo's absence, drawing criticism across European media.
